## Source

::: {.callout-note}
Note: This includes outpatients and admitted patients. The following ICD-10 codes were used: Principal Diagnosis: T36-T50 (excludes ‘adverse effect’ or ‘underdosing’ as indicated by the values of 5 and 6 in the 5th/6th character (for T36.9, T37.9, T39.9, T41.4, T42.7, T43.9, T45.9, T47.9, and T49.9, a 5th character; for all others, a 6th character); and ‘sequela’ as indicated by the value of ‘S’ in the 7th character; e.g., T400X5S, T400X6S).
:::
